jobs.title: Country Security Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Country Security Manager** to join our **Security** team in **a South Sudan Field Office**. This role is based in an isolated area where you will oversee the safety and security of our staff and operations. Through humanitarian work, the goal and purpose of Samaritan's Purse are to help people in Jesus' name and share the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

In the role of Country Security Manager,you will have the opportunity to:

- Maintain a personal, active relationship with Jesus Christ and is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ
- Cultivate strategic partnerships with local leaders, government officials, and security professionals to safeguard all Samaritan's Purse personnel in high-risk environments
- Constantly assess risks by analyzing both open-source and sensitive intelligence to keep security threats at the national and local levels accurately documented
- Report key political, economic, and social developments regularly to leadership to support timely decision-making focused on safety and mission continuity
- Lead, train, and equip a team of local security officers as a vital part of the security structure in developing or conflict-affected regions
- Be prepared to lead during emergencies and activate Samaritan's Purse's disaster responses
- Other duties as assigned

## **What are the qualifications?**

***Serve with Excellence***

As a qualified candidate, you will have the following skills and experience:

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Minimum of one year of management experience, preferably in a disaster location
- Spiritual maturity; ability to lead direct reports in their growing relationship with Jesus Christ
- Diplomacy and negotiating skills; coordinate with other agencies, build and maintain positive working relationships
- Understanding of complex security situations and ability to advise program design accordingly
- Ability to analyze information, develop a complete picture of security situations, and communicate effectively to leadership, both verbally and in written form
- Flexibility and adaptability; critical thinking skills
- Ability to communicate and interact well with people of different educational, linguistic, cultural, and socio-economic backgrounds
- Previous international military experience (preferred) or relevant experience in an international field assignment, managing security concerns
- 12 credit hours of college-level Biblical Studies (required); if not already completed, an opportunity to meet and complete the requirement is available upon hire.

## **What are the benefits?**

***Walk in Bold Faith***

Samaritan's Purse is proud to offer a competitive benefits package, including:

**International:**

- International medical, prescription, dental and vision insurance
- Paid Family Medical Leave
- Retirement savings plan
- Paid holidays
- 12 vacation/personal days
- 10 sick days
- When at IHQ, on-site Medical Clinic (staff and dependents)

**Type:** Full Time

**Department:** Security

**Location:** South Sudan

**Language Requirement:** Fluency in English (Required)

**Travel:** Frequent travel to field sites and project locations is required

**Accompaniment:** Unaccompanied

jobs.title: Consultoría especialista de medios de vida pecuarios y pesqueros para apoyar en Acciones Anticipatorias de El Niño en los Municipios Cruz Salmerón Aco
jobs.description:
DRC Venezuela busca una persona Consultor(a) en Medios de Vida Pecuarios y Pesqueros que pueda brindar asistencia técnica especializada a hogares dedicados a la producción pecuaria de traspatio y la pesca artesanal para fortalecer la protección y resiliencia de sus medios de vida frente a los impactos asociados al fenómeno de El Niño.

**1. Antecedentes**

El Danish Refugee Council (DRC) es una organización humanitaria internacional que trabaja en más de 40 países. Brinda protección y asistencia a personas refugiadas, desplazadas internas, retornadas, migrantes y comunidades de acogida, siguiendo los principios humanitarios de humanidad, neutralidad, imparcialidad e independencia.

DRC Venezuela opera desde Caracas y cinco bases: Maracaibo, Guasdualito, Carúpano, Sur del Lago y La Guaira. En el estado Sucre, DRC implementa acciones orientadas a fortalecer la resiliencia de las comunidades frente a los efectos del fenómeno de El Niño y los períodos prolongados de sequía. En los municipios Cruz Salmerón Acosta y Valdez, las comunidades han reportado una disminución de las precipitaciones, aumento de las temperaturas y afectaciones sobre la disponibilidad de agua, con impactos directos en la producción agrícola, la pesca artesanal y los ingresos de los hogares. Asimismo, se identifican pérdidas productivas recurrentes y una creciente presión sobre los medios de vida que sostienen la seguridad alimentaria de las familias.

En respuesta a este contexto, DRC implementará acciones anticipatorias para proteger los medios de vida agrícolas y pesqueros mediante la entrega de insumos productivos, asistencia técnica y fortalecimiento de capacidades que permitan reducir las pérdidas asociadas a la sequía y mantener la continuidad de las actividades productivas. Para ello, se requiere la contratación de un(a) Consultor(a) en Medios de Vida Pecuarios y Pesqueros, responsable de brindar acompañamiento técnico especializado, desarrollar procesos formativos y apoyar la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades previstas por el proyecto.

**2. Objetivos**

**Objetivo general:**

Fortalecer la resiliencia y la capacidad de protección de los medios de vida de hogares dedicados a la pesca artesanal y la cría de animales de traspatio en los municipios Cruz Salmerón Acosta y Valdez, mediante procesos de identificación técnica, formación, asistencia especializada y acceso a insumos productivos que contribuyan a reducir las pérdidas ocasionadas por la sequía y los efectos asociados al fenómeno de El Niño.

**Objetivos específicos:**

1. **Realizar la evaluación y selección técnica de los potenciales beneficiarios de los componentes pesquero y pecuario**, mediante diagnósticos de campo que permitan identificar las condiciones productivas, necesidades, capacidades y vulnerabilidades de los hogares, de acuerdo con los criterios establecidos por DRC.
2. **Diseñar e impartir un programa de formación para la protección de los medios de vida pesqueros y pecuarios frente a los efectos de la sequía**, abordando temas relacionados con la gestión sostenible del recurso pesquero, buenas prácticas de pesca artesanal, manejo y conservación de equipos e insumos, así como prácticas de alimentación, sanidad, bioseguridad y manejo de animales de traspatio en contextos de escasez hídrica.
3. **Brindar asistencia técnica para la identificación de necesidades productivas y la definición de los kits e insumos más adecuados para cada hogar participante,** así como acompañar su uso e implementación con el fin de fortalecer y proteger los medios de vida pesqueros y pecuarios frente a los efectos de la sequía y el fenómeno de El Niño.
4. **Desarrollar una evaluación final de los beneficiarios y elaborar un informe técnico de resultados**, que documente la implementación de las actividades, los principales logros alcanzados, las mejoras observadas en las capacidades productivas y de resiliencia de los hogares participantes, y las recomendaciones para fortalecer la protección de los medios de vida pesqueros y pecuarios frente a futuras amenazas climáticas.

**3. Alcance del trabajo**

La consultoría cubre los siguientes componentes:

**Objetivo específico**

1. Realizar la evaluación y selección técnica de los potenciales beneficiarios de los componentes pesquero y pecuario
2. Diseñar e impartir un programa de formación para la protección de los medios de vida pesqueros y pecuarios frente a los efectos de la sequía
3. Brindar asistencia técnica para la identificación de necesidades productivas y la definición de los kits e insumos más adecuados para cada hogar participante
4. Desarrollar una evaluación final de los beneficiarios y elaborar un informe técnico de resultados

**Metas**

1. Evaluar al menos a 100 hogares pesqueros, para seleccionar 90 hogares que cumplan con los criterios (línea de base)
2. Evaluar al menos a 40 hogares con cría de animales traspatio, para seleccionar 30 hogares que cumplan con los criterios (línea de base)
3. Diseñar un programa formativo para medios de vida pesqueros, de 4 sesiones, para un total de 16 horas formativas por cada grupo.
4. Impartir talleres de formación dirigidas a pescadores organizados en al menos tres grupos de 30 participantes cada uno, para un total de 90 personas capacitadas.
5. Diseñar un programa formativo para cría de animales traspatio, de 4 sesiones, para un total de 16 horas formativas por cada grupo.
6. Impartir talleres de formación dirigida a 30 pequeños productores, para un total de 30 personas capacitadas.
7. Definir kits personalizados de acuerdo a la necesidad de cada participante, para 60 pescadores y 30 personas con cría de animales traspatio.
8. Acompañar en la entrega de los kits en caso de requerir explicar detalles técnicos del uso de determinados equipos entregados.
9. Aplicar una línea de salida a los participantes (92 encuestas)
10. Elaborar 1 informe técnico de resultados

**Zonas de implementación**

- Comunidades de los Municipios Cruz Salmerón Acosta y Valdez
- Comunidades de los Municipios Cruz Salmerón Acosta y Valdez: Espacios comunitarios ubicados por DRC para realizar la formación
- Comunidades de los Municipios Cruz Salmerón Acosta y Valdez: Espacios comunitarios ubicados por DRC para realizar las entregas.
- Comunidades de los Municipios Cruz Salmerón Acosta y Valdez: Espacio para realizar línea de salida puede ser mediante visitas domiciliarias o acordando con la comunidad un espacio céntrico para los participantes

**Nota:** la persona consultora no tendrá que cubrir los costos de traslados a las comunidades ni la adquisición de materiales formativos, toda vez que serán cubiertos por DRC.

**4. Productos esperados**

Los productos se entregan de forma progresiva durante el contrato, según las prioridades que fije el Líder de recuperación económica con el Gerente de base. Los plazos y productos son indicativos y se cuentan desde la firma del contrato.

**Producto**

1. Diagnóstico inicial, plan de trabajo detallado y fichas técnicas definitivas de los kits de pesca y kits pecuarios - **Plazo indicativo:** Semana 2.
2. Informe de evaluación diagnóstica y selección técnica de los potenciales beneficiarios del componente pecuario y pesquero - **Plazo indicativo:** Semanas 3-5
3. Diseñar dos programas de formación para la protección de los medios de vida pesqueros y pecuarios frente a los efectos de la sequía - **Plazo indicativo:** Semanas 5-6
4. Informe de facilitación de dos programas de formación para la protección de los medios de vida pesqueros y pecuarios frente a los efectos de la sequía - **Plazo indicativo:** Semanas 7-11
5. Desarrollar una evaluación final de los beneficiarios y elaborar un informe técnico de resultados - **Plazo indicativo:** Semanas 12-14

Cada mes la persona consultora entrega, junto con su factura, un timesheet con las horas trabajadas por componente y un breve reporte de avance.

**5. Dedicación, modalidad y supervisión**

- **Período:** desde la firma del contrato, prevista para noviembre de 2026, hasta febrero de 2027. Puede extenderse por enmienda según necesidades y presupuesto.
- **Dedicación:** por horas, según las necesidades del programa. El total no puede superar **640 horas**, DRC no garantiza un mínimo de horas.
- **Modalidad:** Presencial. El consultor deberá trasladarse con el equipo de DRC a las comunidades de intervención del proyecto, en el cronograma acordado con la oficina de la base de DRC.
- **Supervisión:** La coordinación diaria es con el Gerente de Recuperación Económica. También habrá coordinación con Supply cuando aplique.
- **Recursos que aporta DRC:** acceso a la documentación interna necesaria, costos de traslado a comunidades y material didáctico requerido. La persona consultora usa su propio equipo y conexión, así como la propiedad intelectual del desarrollo de las formaciones.

**6. Perfil requerido**

**Requisitos obligatorios**

- Profesional universitario en Medicina Veterinaria, Zootecnia, Ingeniería en Producción Animal, Ingeniería Agropecuaria, Ingeniería Pesquera, Biología o carreras afines relacionadas con los sectores pecuario, pesquero y el fortalecimiento de medios de vida rurales.
- Mínimo dos (2) años de experiencia profesional comprobable en el diseño, implementación o acompañamiento de proyectos vinculados a la producción pecuaria, pesca artesanal, extensión rural o fortalecimiento de medios de vida agropecuarios y pesqueros.
- Experiencia en la realización de diagnósticos productivos y caracterización de beneficiarios, incluyendo la identificación de necesidades, capacidades y oportunidades de fortalecimiento de medios de vida rurales.
- Experiencia en el desarrollo e implementación de procesos de formación, asistencia técnica y acompañamiento productivo dirigidos a productores agropecuarios, pescadores artesanales, organizaciones comunitarias o promotores locales.
- Conocimiento y experiencia en enfoques de adaptación al cambio climático y gestión de riesgos en sistemas productivos agropecuarios, incluyendo medidas orientadas a fortalecer la resiliencia de los medios de vida rurales frente a eventos climáticos extremos.
- Experiencia de trabajo de campo con comunidades rurales, poblaciones vulnerables, personas desplazadas, migrantes, refugiadas y/o comunidades de acogida.
- Capacidad demostrada para facilitar procesos participativos, relacionarse con diversos actores comunitarios e institucionales, coordinar actividades en terreno y trabajar de manera efectiva con equipos multidisciplinarios.
- Habilidades para la elaboración de informes técnicos, sistematización de resultados y presentación de recomendaciones derivadas de procesos de diagnóstico, capacitación y asistencia técnica.
- Disponibilidad para iniciar en noviembre de 2026 y trasladarse a las comunidades de los municipios indicados, de preferencia en horarios de la mañana.

**Requisitos deseables**

- Experiencia previa de trabajo con organizaciones humanitarias, agencias de cooperación internacional o programas de recuperación temprana y resiliencia.
- Conocimiento de los sistemas productivos pecuarios, pesqueros y de subsistencia predominantes en el estado Sucre u otras zonas rurales y costeras de Venezuela.

**7. Contenido y presentación de la oferta**

Las ofertas deben incluir:

1. **CV** de la persona consultora, con tres referencias profesionales verificables.
2. Propuesta de los dos contenidos formativos (preliminar) de cada programa: de cría de animales traspatio, y pesquero, detallando la siguiente información:

**Número de módulo / Nombre de la sesión / Contenido a abordar propuesto / Horas requeridas / Material didáctico requerido**

1

2

3

4

**Total horas:**

3.**Oferta financiera:** tarifa diaria en USD, **todo incluido** (honorarios, impuestos, equipo, conexión y cualquier otro costo), por una jornada de 8 horas. La tarifa horaria se calcula como la tarifa diaria dividida entre 8.

4.**Documentos administrativos:** RIF vigente, documento de identidad o registro mercantil, y formulario de registro de proveedor de DRC.

5.Declaración firmada de ausencia de conflicto de interés y aceptación del Código de Conducta de Proveedores de DRC.

No se solicita propuesta técnica.

Las ofertas se envían a rfq.ven@drc.ngo antes del 25/11/2026 indicando en el asunto la referencia **Consultoría Medíos de Vida Sucre**. Las preguntas se reciben hasta 20/11/2026 y las respuestas se comparten con todos los oferentes. Las ofertas recibidas fuera de plazo no serán consideradas.

**8. Criterios de evaluación**

Las ofertas que cumplan los requisitos administrativos y obligatorios se evalúan con una ponderación de 70 % técnica y 30 % financiera. La evaluación técnica se basa en el CV y las referencias. Solo pasan a la evaluación financiera las ofertas con al menos 49 de 70 puntos técnicos. DRC puede entrevistar a las personas mejor puntuadas.

**Criterio**

- Formación académica en Medicina Veterinaria, Zootecnia, Ingeniería de Producción Animal, Ingeniería Pesquera, Ingeniería Agropecuaria, Biología o áreas afines - **20 Puntos**
- Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de producción pecuaria y pesca artesanal, incluyendo el fortalecimiento de medios de vida rurales, la asistencia técnica a productores y pescadores, y la implementación de estrategias de resiliencia, adaptación al cambio climático y gestión del riesgo frente a eventos climáticos extremos - **20 Puntos**
- Experiencia demostrable en diagnósticos productivos, selección de beneficiarios, capacitación y asistencia técnica a productores agropecuarios y pescadores artesanales - **15 Puntos**
- Calidad de la propuesta metodológica para la ejecución de la consultoría - **15 Puntos**

**Total técnico: 70 Puntos**

Oferta financiera: tarifa diaria más baja / tarifa evaluada × 30 - 30 **Puntos**

**Total: 100 Puntos**

**9. Condiciones contractuales**

- **Contrato:** Contrato de Servicios de Consultoría de DRC, con las Condiciones Generales de Contrato y el Código de Conducta de Proveedores de DRC como anexos obligatorios.
- **Pagos:** mensuales, por transferencia, según las horas efectivamente trabajadas, a la tarifa horaria derivada de la tarifa diaria ofertada. Cada pago requiere factura válida y timesheet aprobado por el Gerente de base. Se aplican las retenciones de ley. El monto total no puede superar el equivalente a 640 horas.
- **Confidencialidad:** toda la información de DRC, de sus donantes, de su personal y de las personas participantes es confidencial. Los productos de la consultoría son propiedad de DRC.
- **Protección de datos:** el tratamiento de datos personales, incluidos los de personas beneficiarias, sigue las políticas de protección de datos de DRC.
- **Conducta:** la persona consultora firma y cumple el Código de Conducta de DRC, incluida la tolerancia cero frente a la explotación y el abuso sexual, el fraude y la corrupción.
- **Conflicto de interés:** no pueden participar personas de DRC Venezuela ni que tengan vínculos con personal involucrado en esta contratación.
- **Derecho de DRC:** DRC puede aceptar o rechazar cualquier oferta, total o parcialmente, sin obligación de justificar su decisión.

jobs.title: Programme Officer - TradeMark Africa - Nigeria
jobs.description:
**Location** Abuja, Nigeria, based at the joint TTF-ECOWAS project office
**Department** Programmes
**Reports to** Programme Manager and Customs Specialist, TTF-ECOWAS
**Direct reports** None

## Job Summary

TradeMark Africa (TMA) is seeking a Programme Officer to support delivery of its work under the ECOWAS Trade and Transport Facilitation Programme (TTF-ECOWAS). The programme is the ECOWAS-anchored component of the EU’s Trade and Transport Facilitation Measures for Strategic Corridors in West Africa. GIZ leads implementation in partnership with TMA and ENABEL.

Working closely with the Programme Manager, the Programme Officer will track agreed actions and deadlines, keep records and monitoring data current, and follow up with consultants and partners. The role also coordinates meeting and workshop logistics and flags delays, risks and implementation issues early.

## Key Responsibilities

- **Programme delivery and implementation support** Maintain activity plans, schedules, budget tracking sheets, risk registers and programme records. Support procurement documentation, track consultant and partner deliverables, and keep TMA’s internal project records up to date.
- **Monitoring, reporting and consortium coordination** Collect and analyse quantitative and qualitative results data, including gender-disaggregated data, and draft inputs for progress and annual reports. Maintain shared coordination tools with GIZ and ENABEL, support committee meetings, and compile evidence for audits and reviews.
- **Stakeholder coordination** Liaise with ECOWAS directorates, national ministries, customs administrations and other agencies. Coordinate workshops, training sessions and technical meetings with the Project Assistant, and follow up on agreed actions.
- **Communications, visibility and knowledge management** Prepare briefs, presentations and programme updates. Document lessons and good practices, contribute content to programme communications, and help meet EU and TMA visibility requirements.
- **Gender, inclusion and safeguards** Help integrate gender equality and inclusion into programme activities, with attention to women, youth and small-scale cross-border traders. Ensure safeguarding, environmental and climate considerations are addressed during implementation, and escalate concerns promptly.

## Qualifications and Experience

- Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in International Trade, Development Studies, Economics or Business Administration.
- At least **three years of relevant experience for postgraduate degree holders** or **five years for undergraduate degree holders** in supporting donor-funded projects, with hands-on experience in project coordination, monitoring and reporting.

## Essential Skills and Languages

- Good understanding of Project Cycle Management, including planning, activity tracking, risk management and reporting.
- Practical experience with data management, monitoring systems and results reporting.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and familiarity with project management tools.
- Good analytical, report-writing and problem-solving skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle competing priorities under pressure.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders and within a multi-partner team.
- Initiative, self-motivation and a collaborative approach.
- Fluency in written and spoken English.

## Desirable Qualifications, Experience and Skills

- Professional training or certification in Project Cycle Management, project management such as PRINCE2 or PMP, or monitoring and evaluation.
- Familiarity with trade facilitation, customs or regional integration initiatives.
- Experience with EU-funded or multi-partner programmes.
- Working knowledge of French.
- Familiarity with ECOWAS institutions and with trade and customs agencies in Nigeria.

jobs.title: Human Resources Officer, West Africa - TradeMark Africa - Côte d'Ivoire
jobs.description:
**Location** Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire
**Department** Human Resources
**Reports to** Senior Human Resources Manager
**Direct reports** None

## Job Summary

TradeMark Africa (TMA) is seeking a Human Resources Officer to support staff and managers across assigned West African countries. Based in Abidjan, the Officer will advise on employee relations and coordinate recruitment, onboarding, payroll, benefits, performance management, and learning and development.

The Officer will help ensure that TMA’s HR policies and practices comply with applicable employment legislation in each country. The role will use workforce data to identify risks and improve HR services, and will provide agreed cover for other country offices and headquarters during absences.

## Key Responsibilities

- **HR advice and employee relations** Advise managers and employees on HR policies, performance, conduct, grievances, disciplinary matters, absence and workplace conflict. Maintain confidential case records, coordinate investigations and legal input when required, and escalate material risks. Support organisational change, staff engagement, performance reviews and learning and development.
- **Workforce planning and reporting** Help country and functional leaders forecast staffing needs and review organisational structures. Track headcount and employment costs, maintain reliable employee data, and report workforce trends and risks.
- **Recruitment, onboarding and employee administration** Coordinate approved recruitment, including vacancy announcements, screening and interviews. Follow up on reference and background checks, prepare offer letters and contracts for approval, and coordinate onboarding, statutory registration, probation reviews, transfers and exits.
- **Payroll, employee records and benefits** Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with HR, Finance and Employers of Record, check payroll outputs for accuracy, and resolve queries. Maintain employee and leave records in line with data protection requirements. Administer insurance, the Employee Assistance Programme and staff welfare support.
- **Staff mobility and expatriate support** Coordinate relocation, immigration, visas, work permits, statutory registration and other assignment arrangements for expatriate staff and their dependants. Liaise with internal teams and external advisers when specialist guidance is required.
- **Employment compliance and service providers** Monitor changes in employment legislation and statutory requirements, maintain country compliance calendars, and support filings and updates to policies and contracts. Manage Employers of Record and other HR service providers, including service quality, compliance, invoicing and issue resolution.
- **Audits, controls and service improvement** Prepare evidence for internal and external audits, track corrective actions and improve HR processes, data quality and service delivery. Apply TMA’s safeguarding and risk management procedures and promptly report concerns, including suspected fraud, bribery or corruption.
- **HR cover for other offices and headquarters** Handle employee queries, casework and approvals within delegated authority during agreed periods of cover. Apply the relevant local legislation and policy, escalate complex matters and document open items for handover.

## Qualifications and Experience

- Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology or a related field.
- Recognised professional qualification or certification in Human Resource Management, such as CIPD, SHRM or equivalent.
- At least **five years of progressive HR experience for undergraduate degree holders** or **three years for postgraduate degree holders**, including substantial responsibility for HR operations in a medium-sized organisation.
- Demonstrated experience supporting employees and managers across multiple countries, preferably in West Africa, and applying country-specific employment legislation and HR practices.
- Experience managing employee relations cases, coordinating payroll and benefits, managing HR vendors and applying compliance controls.
- Experience providing HR support across multiple jurisdictions, including covering for colleagues and quickly learning unfamiliar legal and policy requirements.

## Essential Skills and Languages

- Full professional proficiency in **English and French**, including the ability to advise employees and managers and prepare clear HR correspondence in both languages.
- Sound knowledge of HR operations, employee relations, employment compliance, payroll controls, data protection and HR information systems.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to use workforce data to identify trends, assess risks and determine follow-up actions.
- Ability to handle sensitive matters with confidentiality, discretion, empathy and procedural fairness.
- Sound judgement, integrity and resilience, with the ability to work independently, adjust priorities across countries and escalate material risks promptly.
- Excellent communication, influencing, stakeholder management, presentation and problem-solving skills. Ability to build effective working relationships across cultures, functions and locations.
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly within West Africa and occasionally to headquarters or other countries, with flexibility across time zones when providing cover.

## Desirable Qualifications

jobs.title: Programme Manager, Customs - TradeMark Africa - Nigeria

## Job Summary

TradeMark Africa (TMA) is seeking a Programme Manager to lead day-to-day delivery of its work under the ECOWAS Trade and Transport Facilitation Programme (TTF-ECOWAS), with a focus on customs operations. The programme is the ECOWAS-anchored component of the EU’s Trade and Transport Facilitation Measures for Strategic Corridors in West Africa. GIZ leads implementation in partnership with TMA and ENABEL.

The Programme Manager will implement approved workplans and budgets, provide technical input on customs reforms and serve as TMA’s operational contact for GIZ and ENABEL. The role dedicates approximately 80% of its time to TTF-ECOWAS and 20% to supporting other TMA programming in Nigeria.

## Key Responsibilities

- **TTF-ECOWAS programme management and delivery (40%)** Develop detailed activity plans and oversee delivery, procurement and contracts. Track spending and forecasts, coordinate workshops and technical meetings, maintain audit-ready records, and supervise the Project Assistant. Apply TMA, EU and safeguarding requirements across activities.
- **Customs technical support (20%)** Advise on customs data exchange, interconnectivity of customs and transit systems such as SIGMAT, common external tariffs, tariff schedules, rules of origin and customs management regulations. Support pilot Member States in transposing ECOWAS customs instruments. Work with the ECOWAS Customs Union and Taxation Directorate, national customs administrations, TMA specialists and GIZ advisers.
- **Monitoring, reporting and coordination (20%)** Verify results data and prepare TMA’s narrative and financial inputs to consolidated reports. Coordinate operational planning with GIZ and ENABEL, support steering and technical committee meetings, and document lessons and programme results.
- **Nigeria programme support (20%)** Support planning, procurement, monitoring and quarterly reporting for other TMA projects in Nigeria. Contribute to new project design and engagement with government, private-sector and development partners.

## Qualifications and Experience

- Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Economics, International Trade, Customs Administration, International Trade Law or Development Studies.
- At least **10 years of relevant work experience** for undergraduate degree holders or **eight years** for postgraduate degree holders.
- At least **five years of experience in customs administration, customs modernisation or trade facilitation programming**, preferably in West Africa.
- At least **three years of experience managing donor-funded projects**, including procurement, contract management, budget tracking and reporting.
- At least **three years of experience supervising staff**.

## Essential Skills and Languages

- Good knowledge of customs procedures, transit regimes, customs IT systems, and ECOWAS trade and customs instruments, including the ECOWAS Trade Liberalisation Scheme (ETLS).
- Strong programme management skills, with attention to detail in planning, procurement and financial follow-up.
- Good understanding of regional integration and the socio-political context in Nigeria and West Africa.
- Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to draft reports and present to senior counterparts.
- Ability to work constructively and diplomatically with government officials, regional institutions and partner organisations, and to collaborate within a multi-partner team.
- Initiative and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

## Desirable Qualifications, Experience and Skills

- Professional training in customs or project planning and management.
- Experience with EU-funded programmes and knowledge of EU contracting, financial and reporting rules.
- Working knowledge of French.
- Familiarity with digital trade and customs connectivity systems in West Africa.

jobs.title: Country Director / Strategic Expert - TradeMark Africa - Nigeria
jobs.description:

## Job Summary

TradeMark Africa (TMA) is seeking a Country Director to lead its Nigeria team and portfolio and serve as its Strategic Expert for the ECOWAS Trade and Transport Facilitation Programme (TTF-ECOWAS). The Country Director will develop and implement TMA’s Nigeria strategy, grow the country portfolio, and coordinate with regional corridor programmes, including the Abidjan–Lagos corridor.

TTF-ECOWAS is the ECOWAS-anchored component of the EU’s Trade and Transport Facilitation Measures for Strategic Corridors in West Africa. GIZ leads implementation in partnership with TMA and ENABEL. The Country Director will hold TMA’s programme budget, be accountable for its delivery and results, and serve as TMA’s day-to-day counterpart to the ECOWAS Commission, consortium partners and the EU on the programme.

## Key Responsibilities

- **TTF-ECOWAS strategy, budget and delivery (60%)** Set the direction for TMA’s contribution and lead its part of the six-month inception phase, including recruitment, office setup and monitoring arrangements. Oversee workplans, budgets, expenditure, procurement and reporting. Represent TMA on the regional steering and technical coordination committees and connect regional reforms with corridor-level implementation.
- **Nigeria country programme delivery and development (15%)** Develop and implement TMA’s Nigeria strategy in line with regional priorities and Nigeria’s implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). Lead delivery of the existing portfolio, develop new programmes and secure donor investment. Integrate inclusion, safeguarding and climate considerations into programme delivery.
- **Stakeholder engagement and partnership development (10%)** Build senior relationships with the Government of Nigeria, the ECOWAS Commission, the AfCFTA Secretariat, development partners, the private sector and civil society. Represent TMA in national and international forums.

## Qualifications and Experience

- Undergraduate or postgraduate degree, preferably in Economics, Development Studies, International Trade, Planning, Finance or Management.

## Essential Skills and Languages

- Ability to think strategically and plan and deliver complex programmes.
- Strong political networks and influencing skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly in writing and in person.
- Well-developed technical knowledge of the AfCFTA, ECOWAS trade and transport instruments, customs, trade facilitation and regional trade integration in West Africa and across Africa.
- Proven ability to lead diverse teams, manage performance, deliver change and achieve results.

jobs.title: Spécialiste Parc Auto (Grade C) - Millennium Challenge Account (MCA) - Côte d’Ivoire Régional
jobs.description:
## À propos de MCA – Côte d’Ivoire Régional

Le Millennium Challenge Account (MCA-Côte d’Ivoire Régional), en collaboration avec le Gouvernement de la République de Côte d’Ivoire (GoCI) et le Millennium Challenge Corporation (“MCC”) du Gouvernement des États-Unis d’Amérique, met en œuvre un projet dans le cadre du Compact d’un montant de 322,5 millions de dollars. Ce programme vise à renforcer la sécurité énergétique régionale, à réduire les coûts de l’énergie et à favoriser l’accès à une électricité fiable et abordable en Afrique de l’Ouest, en améliorant la capacité de la Côte d’Ivoire à échanger de l’électricité sur le marché régional.

## Objectif du poste

Le Spécialiste Parc Auto, rattaché au service des Moyens Généraux de la Direction Administrative et Financière (DAF) et placé sous la supervision du Manager Moyens Généraux, est chargé d’organiser, de gérer et de suivre l’ensemble du parc automobile du MCA-Côte d’Ivoire Régional, afin de garantir la disponibilité, la sécurité et l’utilisation rationnelle des véhicules au service des activités du siège et des missions sur les sites du Projet régional de l’électricité.

À ce titre, il assure la planification des déplacements, la maintenance des véhicules, la gestion du carburant, ainsi que l’encadrement direct des chauffeurs et la tenue des registres d’utilisation et d’inventaire, dans le respect des procédures administratives du MCA, des directives de la MCC (passation de marchés, gestion des biens, santé et sécurité au travail) et de la réglementation ivoirienne. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Spécialiste Moyens Généraux, l’Assistant(e) Administration/Réception, le service Finances et Budget, la Direction de la Passation des Marchés (DPM) et la Direction de la Performance Environnementale et Sociale (DPES), au service de l’ensemble des directions du MCA-CI Régional.

## Principales responsabilités

**A. Gestion du parc automobile et des déplacements professionnels**

- Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et actualiser les procédures de gestion du parc automobile conformément au Manuel des procédures administratives du MCA-CI Régional et aux directives de la MCC.
- Planifier et coordonner les déplacements du personnel, des consultants, des visiteurs officiels et des missions de la MCC, au siège et sur les sites du Programme.
- Manager l'équipe des chauffeurs en assurant la planification des activités, la gestion des rotations et permanences, le suivi de la discipline, l'évaluation des performances et le développement des compétences.
- Assurer l'affectation optimale des véhicules et veiller à leur utilisation efficace, sécurisée et conforme aux besoins opérationnels.
- Organiser et superviser la maintenance préventive et corrective des véhicules, assurer le suivi des réparations et contrôler la qualité des prestations fournies.
- Gérer l'approvisionnement en carburant, suivre les consommations et veiller à la justification des dépenses associées.
- Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de gestion de flotte (kilométrage, consommation, disponibilité, coûts d'exploitation) et produire des analyses permettant d'optimiser les ressources.
- Garantir la conformité administrative et réglementaire des véhicules (assurances, immatriculations, visites techniques, cartes grises et autres autorisations requises).
- Gérer les sinistres et accidents, assurer les déclarations auprès des parties concernées et suivre les dossiers jusqu'à leur clôture.
- Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité routière, de santé-sécurité au travail et à la bonne application des procédures de prévention des risques.
- Contribuer à la préparation des spécifications techniques, des dossiers d'acquisition et au suivi des contrats relatifs aux véhicules, carburants, assurances et prestations de maintenance.
- Préparer, suivre et contrôler le budget de fonctionnement du parc automobile et proposer des mesures d'optimisation des coûts.
- Veiller à l'utilisation exclusivement professionnelle des véhicules et prévenir tout usage abusif, fraude ou gaspillage.

**B. Support administratif**

- Gérer et assurer le suivi des contrats-cadres relatifs aux voyages, aux locations de véhicules, aux services généraux et aux prestations logistiques.
- Assurer le suivi budgétaire des contrats-cadres relevant de son périmètre, contrôler la consommation des budgets, anticiper les besoins de renouvellement et produire des analyses périodiques afin de garantir une utilisation optimale des ressources et la maîtrise des coûts.
- Organiser les voyages professionnels du personnel, des consultants et des visiteurs, notamment les réservations de transport, d'hébergement et les formalités logistiques associées.
- Planifier et coordonner la réservation des salles de réunion, ateliers, formations et événements du Programme.
- Superviser les fournisseurs de services généraux et veiller au respect des engagements contractuels et des niveaux de service attendus.
- Assurer la gestion des stocks de fournitures et consommables ainsi que le suivi de leur approvisionnement.
- Tenir à jour l'inventaire des biens, équipements et immobilisations du Programme et réaliser les contrôles physiques périodiques.
- Assurer le suivi, le marquage, la traçabilité et la bonne conservation des actifs conformément aux exigences du MCA-CI Régional et de la MCC.
- Coordonner les opérations d'installation, d'aménagement et de réaménagement des espaces de travail.
- Préparer et suivre les demandes d'achats, les bons de commande, les contrats et les factures relevant de son périmètre de responsabilité.
- Produire des rapports périodiques sur la gestion de la flotte, des actifs et des moyens généraux, assortis de recommandations d'amélioration.
- Garantir le respect des procédures administratives, logistiques, de santé-sécurité ainsi que des politiques et directives de la MCC.
- Contribuer à la préparation des opérations de transfert, de cession ou de disposition des actifs à la clôture du Compact, conformément aux directives applicables.
- Exécuter toute autre tâche confiée par la Direction de MCA-CI Régional afin de contribuer à la réussite du Projet régional de l’électricité et à l’atteinte des objectifs du Compact.

## Compétences requises

- Licence (Bac + 3) minimum en logistique, transport, gestion, administration ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent ; un diplôme en mécanique automobile ou une certification en gestion de flotte constitue un atout.
- Au moins cinq (5) années d’expérience professionnelle pertinente dans la gestion de parc automobile ou de la logistique des transports, dont une expérience avérée dans l’encadrement d’une équipe de chauffeurs.
- Expérience au sein de projets ou d’organisations financés par des bailleurs de fonds (MCC, Banque mondiale, BAD, USAID, agences des Nations Unies ou institutions similaires) ; une expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie ou des infrastructures constitue un atout.
- Gestion des services généraux et de l'administration
- Gestion des contrats et des fournisseurs
- Suivi budgétaire et contrôle des coûts
- Bonne connaissance des techniques d’entretien et de maintenance des véhicules, notamment des véhicules tout-terrain (4x4) utilisés pour les missions de terrain.
- Expérience avérée dans la mise en place et l’utilisation d’outils de suivi de flotte (registres, tableaux de bord, logiciels de gestion de parc, systèmes de géolocalisation).
- Bonne connaissance de la réglementation ivoirienne en matière de circulation routière, d’assurance automobile et de formalités administratives des véhicules.
- Connaissance des règles de sécurité routière et de santé et sécurité au travail ; une formation en conduite défensive constitue un atout.
- Notions en gestion budgétaire, gestion des stocks et des immobilisations, et en procédures de passation de marchés.
- Maîtrise des outils informatiques courants (Word, Excel, Outlook) et capacité à produire des rapports clairs et chiffrés.
- Permis de conduire valide (catégorie B au minimum) ; la connaissance du réseau routier de la Côte d’Ivoire constitue un atout.
- Grand sens de l’organisation, de l’intégrité et de la rigueur, aptitude à encadrer une équipe et capacité à travailler sous pression et en dehors des heures normales si nécessaire.
- Rédaction de rapports et tableaux de bord
- Excellente maîtrise du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ; la maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un atout.

jobs.title: National Technical Consultant
jobs.description:
**POSITION INFORMATION**

- **Organization:** UNDP Lebanon Through Stars Orbit Consultants and Management Development
- **VA No.: Readvertisement UNDP/LBN/VA26/221**
- **Position Title**: National Technical Consultant
- **Duty Station:** Homebased and assigned duty station: DRM Unit and the Protection and Intervention Division of the information department
- **Duration:** 1.5 months (Total of 6 working days)
- **Vacancy Date of Issue: 11 November 2026**
- **Vacancy Closure Date: 18 November 2026**
- **National or International consultancy:** National consultancy

To review the full Terms of Reference (TOR), please follow link:

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/17a_CYoJcvZb7b1t5HWh1Z6xoVHgAn_Ce/view?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17a_CYoJcvZb7b1t5HWh1Z6xoVHgAn_Ce/view?usp=sharing)

**BACKGROUND**

In 2023, the European Union (EU) has launched a project entitled “Disaster management, Port and Maritime reform for economic recovery” that is implemented by the United Nations Development Programme. This project aims at mitigating the impacts of the current crisis while supporting a people centered recovery and improving human rights through strengthening relevant systems and reinforcing the role of civil society in line with the priorities outlined in the Reform, Recovery and Reconstruction Framework (3RF) for Lebanon.

The project aims at contributing to a secure and safe environment in Lebanon through accountable institutions. In particular, the interventions will contribute to achieving the following outcomes:

- Reinforcing governance and effectiveness in the management of port and maritime affairs, in line with the rule of law and international conventions.
- Strengthening Disaster Management.

The project also seeks to strengthen the institutional, technical, and operational capacities of relevant national authorities and security agencies involved in maritime safety, security, emergency preparedness, and response. It supports improved inter-agency coordination, enhanced operational readiness, and the provision of specialized equipment and technical assistance to enable national institutions to carry out their respective mandates more effectively.

Within this framework, the project provides targeted support to the Internal Security Forces (ISF), particularly its Information Department, to strengthen its maritime operational capabilities. The Information Department relies on rigid inflatable boats (RIBs), including these boats, to carry out its assigned missions at sea. Ensuring the safety, functionality, and operational readiness of these vessels is therefore essential to enabling the Department to effectively fulfill its mandate and maintain its maritime operational capacities.

To this end, the project is supporting the inspection, repair, and rehabilitation of the ISF's RIBs. The required inspections and repair aim to restore these vessels to a safe, functional, and operational condition, enabling the ISF Information Department to resume and effectively carry out its missions at sea.

Given the specialized technical nature of the repairs, a National Technical Consultant will be engaged to support the evaluation of bids and to verify that the equipment and spare parts delivered and installed on the ISF’s RIBs conform to the requirements set out in the RFQ.

The consultant will:

1. **Evaluate bids:** Participate in the technical evaluation of the bids received, assess their compliance with the tender specifications (RFQ) and their compatibility with the boats’ existing systems.
2. **Verify delivery and installation:** Confirm that the delivered equipment and spare parts match what was requested and oversee their installation to ensure it follows the approved specifications and manufacturers’ recommendations.
3. **Inspect and test:** Inspect the completed works, supervise functional testing in coordination with ISF personnel and the supplier, and flag any deviations requiring corrective action.
4. **Report:** Submit a final technical report confirming the conformity and operational status of the repaired boats, noting any outstanding issues and maintenance recommendations.

**SCOPE OF WORK, RESPONSIBILITIES AND DESCRIPTION OF THE PROPOSED ANALYTICAL WORK**

Following the completion of the procurement process and the delivery and repair works of the Sillinger RIB 680 or equivalent, the Consultant will work closely with the project team and relevant stakeholders to provide the required technical expertise and verify the proper evaluation, repair and functionality, and compliance of the equipment with the approved technical specifications and contractual requirements.

**EXPECTED OUTPUTS AND DELIVERABLES**

The Consultant is expected to deliver the following:

- **Deliverable 1: Technical Evaluation Report:** Following participation in the procurement evaluation panel, the Consultant shall provide a technical assessment of the bids received, verifying compliance with the established technical specifications and requirements, and spare parts for the repair of the ISF's RIBs.
- **Deliverable 2: Technical Delivery and Inspection Report:** Following the delivery, installation, and completion of the repair works, the Consultant shall conduct a technical inspection to verify that the supplied equipment and spare parts comply with the approved specifications and contractual requirements. The report assesses the quality of installation, functionality, and operational readiness of the repaired boats, and provide recommendations for technical acceptance and operational use.

**INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS**

The consultant will work under the supervision of the Project Manager. UNDP will be responsible for providing the consultant with all necessary materials if applicable related to the project in a timely, thorough, and transparent manner. The consultant shall rely on his/her own means of transportation, communication, etc. and shall take these fees into consideration while preparing the financial offer.

**DURATION OF WORK**

The consultancy assignment will be conducted over a period of one and a half months, commencing from the date of contract signature. The Consultant is expected to provide a total of 6 working days of services, distributed over the one and a half month assignment period as required.

**DUTY STATION**

The consultant is expected to perform his duties at her/his location, and at his assigned duty station: DRM Unit and the Protection and Intervention Division of the information department.

**STANDARD MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

- **Education:** At least a Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Engineering, or another relevant technical field.
- **Experience:** A minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in the technical assessment, inspection, maintenance, repair, and rehabilitation of maritime vessels, particularly rigid inflatable boats (RIBs), including marine engines and associated equipment, in addition to liaising with ministries and government bodies and coordinating with military agencies.
- **Language:** Fluency in English and Arabic.

**“The Personnel will be covered with Health insurance and Personal accident insurance; the fees shall be deducted from personnel's monthly payment”.**
