jobs.title: Economic and Sustainable Finance Specialist [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Viet Nam is undergoing a period of significant economic transformation, driven by its ambition to achieve high-income status by 2045 while transitioning towards a greener, more resilient and low-carbon development model. These ambitions are taking place in a rapidly evolving global environment, where climate change, technological transformation, changing trade and investment patterns, and increasing demands for sustainable production are reshaping the country's development opportunities and challenges.

Achieving these ambitions will require not only effective public policies and investment, but also new approaches to mobilizing and directing finance towards sustainable development. Public resources alone will not be sufficient to meet Viet Nam's development and climate financing needs. Increasingly, the challenge is to create policy, regulatory and market conditions that can mobilize domestic and international private capital and align financial flows with national development priorities.

UNDP Viet Nam works across several areas where these economic, policy and financing dimensions intersect. These include the energy transition and green growth; carbon markets and carbon pricing; biodiversity and nature finance; climate and disaster risk finance and insurance; circular economy; and sustainable private-sector development. Across these areas, UNDP combines policy advice, institutional support, innovative financing approaches and partnerships with Government, development partners, international financial institutions and the private sector.

As these areas of work evolve, there is an increasing opportunity to connect individual initiatives into a more coherent economic and financing offer. This requires understanding the economic and financial drivers underlying different development challenges; identifying synergies and opportunities across portfolios; assessing emerging policy and market developments; and translating these into strategic policy propositions, programmes and partnerships capable of mobilizing finance on a scale.

Against this background, UNDP Viet Nam is seeking an Economic and Sustainable Finance Specialist to strengthen the Country Office's capacity at the intersection of economic policy, finance and programme development. The Specialist will work across the Country Office portfolio, helping to connect economic and financing analysis with UNDP's policy advisory work, programme development, strategic positioning and resource mobilization.

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the strategic guidance of the Resident Representative, the Economic and Sustainable Finance Specialist will provide integrated economic and financing analysis to strengthen UNDP Viet Nam’s policy positioning, programme development and partnerships.

The Economic and Sustainable Finance Specialist will work across UNDP’s programme portfolio to identify and articulate the economic and financing dimensions of key development transitions, including green growth, energy transition, carbon markets, biodiversity and nature finance, climate and disaster risk finance and insurance, circular economy, and other emerging areas relevant to Viet Nam’s development trajectory.

A central function of the position will be to connect policy, economics and finance: assessing how regulatory developments, public policy, market incentives and financing mechanisms interact; identifying opportunities for public and private capital; and translating these insights into coherent policy propositions, programme concepts, financing solutions and funding proposals.

The Economic and Sustainable Finance Specialist will support the Country Office in bringing together initiatives that may currently sit across different thematic portfolios into a more coherent UNDP economic and financing offer, identifying synergies, gaps and opportunities for scale. The position will also contribute to positioning UNDP with Government, international financial institutions, development finance institutions, development partners and the private sector around emerging economic and financing priorities.

The incumbent will work in close coordination with regional and global UNDP teams.

Provide integrated economic and financing analysis to strengthen UNDP’s programme portfolio and strategic positioning.

- Provide strategic advice to Country Office management and programme teams on economic and financing issues relevant to Viet Nam’s development priorities and UNDP’s programme portfolio;

- Analyze key economic, policy, regulatory and market developments and assess their implications for UNDP’s areas of engagement and future programming;

- Provide economic and financing analysis across priority areas, including green growth and energy transition, carbon markets, biodiversity and nature finance, climate and disaster risk finance and insurance, circular economy, and sustainable private-sector development;

- Assess financing needs, constraints and opportunities, including the respective roles of public finance, private capital and international development finance;

- Analyze economic viability, incentives, risks, distributional implications and potential for scale of different policy and financing approaches;

- Produce concise analytical and policy products, including policy briefs, strategic notes, senior management briefings, speeches and talking points.

Strengthen portfolio integration and develop UNDP’s economic and financing offer

- Work across programme teams to identify connections, complementarities and opportunities among UNDP initiatives and portfolios from an economic and financing perspective;

- Bring together relevant work across areas such as carbon markets, biodiversity finance, insurance and risk finance, energy transition, green growth and circular economy to develop coherent economic and financing propositions;

- Identify emerging policy, market and financing opportunities where UNDP can provide distinctive value and advice on potential areas for programme development and institutional positioning;

- Identify opportunities to move from individual interventions and pilots towards integrated approaches that can be replicated, institutionalized or scaled;

- Connect country-level opportunities with relevant UNDP regional and global expertise, initiatives and financing platforms.

Lead and support programme development, resource mobilization and financing partnerships

- Translate economic and financing analysis into concrete programme concepts, investment propositions and funding proposals aligned with national priorities and UNDP’s comparative advantage;

- Lead or substantively contribute to the preparation of high-quality concept notes, programme documents and funding proposals, working closely with relevant programme teams;

- Strengthening the economic rationale, financing strategy, theory of change and potential for scale and sustainability of new programmes and proposals;

- Identify appropriate financing approaches and instruments — including public finance, private capital, blended finance, risk-sharing mechanisms, insurance and other innovative financing approaches — according to the development challenge being addressed;

- Identify and cultivate opportunities for collaboration and financing with development partners, IFIs, DFIs, financial institutions, investors, foundations and the private sector;

- Support the development of larger and more integrated programmes by connecting opportunities and financing propositions emerging across UNDP’s portfolio.

Provide policy advisory support, partnership engagement and contribute to UNDP knowledge networks

- Provide economic and financing policy advice to Government counterparts and other partners, in close collaboration with relevant UNDP programme teams;

- Support policy dialogue on economic and financing issues related to Viet Nam’s development transitions and facilitate access to relevant regional and global expertise;

- Contribute, in close collaboration with Senior Management, to strengthening partnerships with Government, UN agencies, IFIs, DFIs, bilateral development partners, financial institutions, the private sector, academia and other relevant stakeholders;

- Participate in relevant policy dialogues, conferences, technical discussions and other forums;

- Participate in UNDP regional and global economic and sustainable finance networks and contribute Viet Nam experience and analysis to relevant knowledge initiatives;

- Facilitate the exchange and application of relevant international experience and innovative approaches to Viet Nam’s development context.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Competencies

Core Competencies:

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies

Business Direction & Strategy

- System Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system

Business Management

- Portfolio Management: Ability to select, prioritize and control the organization's programmes and projects in line with its strategic objectives and capacity

- Ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives with regular activities for optimal return on investment. Knowledge and understanding of key principles of project, programme, and portfolio management

- Human-centered Design: Ability to develop solutions to problems by involving the human perspective in all steps of the problem-solving process Knowledge and understanding of human centred design principles and practices

Digital

- Data literacy: Understand the potential as well as the limitations of using data driven innovation. Ability to use a mix of data sources (quantitative, qualitative or real- time techniques) to develop understanding, identify patterns to inform decision making or identify opportunities for further exploration

- Co-creation: Ability to design and facilitate a process that enables a diverse group of stakeholders to solve a common problem, develop practice, or create knowledge together. Ability to embrace diversity, work with a diverse group of stakeholders understand their interests, perspectives and views and tap into them as a source for creativity. Ability to facilitate processes and create conditions that are open for diverse inputs, stimulate collaboration and sharing.

Programme & Policy

- Crisis and Fragility Policy and Engagement: Ability to extract, analyse and visualize data to form meaningful insights and aid effective business decision making

- SDG Integration: Economic Forecasting

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- An advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Economics, Finance, Public Policy, or related fields is required. OR:

- A first-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

- A PhD in Economics, Finance, Public Policy or related field is an advantage.

Experience:

- Minimum of 7 years (with master’s degree) or 9 years (with bachelor’s degree) of progressively responsible professional experience in economics, development finance, sustainable finance, public finance, financial sector development, or related fields.

Required skills and experiences:

- Demonstrated experience in applying economic and financial analysis to development policy, programmes, or investment challenges;

- Demonstrated experience in programme development, including the preparation of concept notes, funding proposals, investment propositions or similar instruments;

- Experience in sustainable or development finance, with exposure to areas such as climate and green finance, carbon markets, biodiversity and nature finance, insurance and risk finance, energy transition, blended finance, or private-sector finance;

- Experience in providing policy or technical advisory support to government institutions and/or engaging with financial institutions, development partners, IFIs, DFIs or the private sector;

- Demonstrated ability to analyze and synthesize complex economic, policy and financing issues and translate them into clear strategic and programmatic recommendations.

Desired skills and experiences:

- Experience working across different development sectors and identifying linkages between policy, economic and financing issues;

- Experience developing partnerships and resource mobilization opportunities with development partners, IFIs, DFIs, financial institutions and/or private-sector actors;

- Experience working in Viet Nam and/or the Asia-Pacific region;

- Prior experience with UN/UNDP, international financial institutions, development finance institutions or other international development organizations;

- Experience working in emerging-market and developing-country contexts.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

jobs.title: Project Associate (abierto para candidatos internos y externos)
jobs.description:
Enfoque por niveles (Tiered Approach)

En consonancia con el compromiso de preservar la capacidad y brindar apoyo al personal que ya forma parte de la Organización, la mayoría de las vacantes del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU se publican mediante un proceso de aplicación por niveles (tiers), donde:

- Nivel 0 (Tier 0) Personal Internacional (IP) del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA), cuyos puestos serán abolidos o cuyos contratos serán terminados o no renovados durante el año 2026.

- Nivel 1 (Tier 1) Otro personal del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA).

- Nivel 2 (Tier 2) Personal del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos temporales (TA), personal con contratos regulares PSA, y Voluntarios de las Naciones Unidas en las categorías de Experto y Especialista.

- Nivel 3 (Tier 3) o sin nivel especificado Todos los demás tipos de contratos dentro del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU, otras agencias y demás candidatos externos. Por favor tenga en cuenta el(los) nivel(es) indicados en el título de la vacante, si lo hay, y asegúrese de que cumple con la elegibilidad para aplicar.

Contexto

A partir de 2025, la oficina del PNUD en Cuba comenzó a implementar un nuevo Programa de Cooperación con el País (CPD, por sus siglas en inglés), acordado con el Gobierno de Cuba, que define las áreas prioritarias de trabajo para el nuevo ciclo de cooperación. Este marco estratégico da continuidad a las prioridades nacionales establecidas en el Programa Nacional de Desarrollo Económico y Social hasta 2030 (PNDES), manteniendo la transformación productiva como uno de sus ejes centrales.

En este contexto, el PNUD en Cuba continúa posicionándose como un socio clave que acompaña al gobierno en la implementación de esta prioridad nacional, tanto a nivel macro como en la gestión de iniciativas a nivel territorial. Su contribución se centra en impulsar procesos de cambio transformacional, promover la innovación y fortalecer la articulación público-privada entre diversos actores económicos, incluidos el sector estatal, las cooperativas y las micro, pequeñas y medianas empresas (Mipymes), favoreciendo así un desarrollo sostenible, inclusivo y con equidad.

La experiencia acumulada desde 2009 en el acompañamiento a la transformación productiva, particularmente en sectores vinculados a la seguridad alimentaria —considerada altamente prioritaria para el país—, se consolida y amplía en el nuevo CPD. Asimismo, se fortalece el apoyo a otros sectores estratégicos y al proceso de descentralización de competencias, orientado a dinamizar el desarrollo económico a nivel territorial.

El área Gobernabilidad y Transformación Productiva del PNUD tiene como principal responsabilidad la gestión e implementación de proyectos alineados con estas prioridades. Este equipo trabaja en estrecha coordinación con las estructuras de gestión de las contrapartes a nivel nacional y local, brindando apoyo técnico, administrativo, logístico y financiero. Además, es responsable de monitorear el progreso de los proyectos, asegurar el cumplimiento de resultados y rendir cuentas tanto a la gerencia del PNUD como a los donantes.

Alcance de trabajo

Las funciones del/la Asociado/a de Proyectos, dando estricto cumplimiento a las normas y procedimientos de PNUD en estrecha vinculación con la/el Analista de Proyecto son:

1. En coordinación con el equipo de adquisiciones del PNUD/Cuba:

- Apoyar, en coordinación con la Unidad de Adquisiciones, la planificación de las adquisiciones y la preparación de insumos para la estrategia de compra, cuya revisión y aprobación se realizará de conformidad con los roles y procedimientos aplicables.

- Velar por el cumplimiento del cronograma de adquisiciones, que considere tiempos comerciales y cronogramas de proyectos técnicos.

- Alertar a la/el Analista de Proyecto de la existencia de dificultades que pongan en riesgo el cumplimiento de el plan de compras y proponer alternativas de solución.

- Apoyar la preparación de las especificaciones técnicas para la adquisición de bienes, cuya validación deberá ser realizada por el área técnica o responsable competente.

- Apoyar los procesos de adquisiciones con énfasis en la coordinación oportuna con los/las beneficiarios/as, contribuyendo a la coordinación y comunicación fluida y oportuna.

- Apoyar al proyecto en la elaboración de términos de referencia para la contratación de los expertos que se requieran.

- Participar en Comités de Evaluación, cuando sea asignado/a y siempre que no exista incompatibilidad con otras funciones desempeñadas en el mismo proceso.

- Dar seguimiento a los procesos de adquisiciones asignados bajo los métodos de adquisición acordados, estableciendo canales de comunicación con los actores involucrados y contribuyendo con observaciones para asegurar las mejores prácticas internacionales de las adquisiciones públicas.

- Brindar apoyo administrativo al seguimiento a los contratos, incluyendo la actualización de información y la coordinación con las partes involucradas, sin asumir, en aquellos procesos en los que haya actuado como Buyer, funciones incompatibles de administración contractual, certificación del cumplimiento técnico, aceptación de entregables o autorización de pagos.

- Asegurar oportunamente la recopilación, revisión administrativa y remisión de la documentación de embarque y demás documentación soporte correspondiente, a el/la Asociado/a de Finanzas, sin certificar la recepción satisfactoria cuando ello resulte incompatible con las funciones desempeñadas en la misma transacción.

- Mantener actualizado y disponible en cualquier momento el archivo electrónico de adquisiciones y contratos.

- Mantener la sobrevista sobre los precios del mercado nacional e internacional para contribuir a preparar los argumentos para la solicitud del presupuesto de contingencias del proyecto.

- Velar por el cumplimiento de la política corporativa, las normas y procedimientos para la implementación de proyectos de cooperación.

- Mantener una relación de trabajo coordinada con el Equipo de Adquisiciones del PNUD y el equipo del proyecto.

2. Proporciona apoyo financiero, programático y administrativo eficaz a la gestión del proyecto en los siguientes temas:

- Asiste a la/el Analista de Proyecto en la logística para el desarrollo de las actividades administrativas relativas a sus responsabilidades, garantizando la gestión y ejecución eficiente y efectiva del proyecto. Esto incluye organización de misiones, equipos técnicos, comités de gestión y directivos, eventos, manejo de agendas, elaboración de documentos y presentaciones, entre otros, según sea requerido.

- Apoya en la preparación oportuna de la información sobre la implementación que solicite la/el Analista de Proyecto y la gerencia del PNUD, con la calidad requerida y asegurando cumplir con los plazos de entrega fijados.

- Contribuye a elaborar los planes de trabajo anuales, velando porque las actividades previstas conduzcan al cumplimiento de los resultados previstos.

- Asegura la disponibilidad de información para los reportes a los donantes, velando por el cumplimiento de lo acordado entre las partes involucradas en el proyecto.

- De conjunto con la/el Analista de Proyecto identificar lecciones aprendidas y buenas prácticas que ayuden a mejorar la gestión del proyecto.

- Apoya a otros/as Asociados/as del Proyecto para garantizar la adecuada gestión financiera del proyecto y sus presupuestos.

- Seguimiento a los procesos de auditoría que se realicen y los planes de acción que resulten de los mismos.

3. Apoyar la generación y el intercambio de conocimientos, así como el fortalecimiento de capacidades en el marco del proyecto.

- Participar en actividades de capacitación y organizar sesiones informativas sobre procedimientos internos para el personal del proyecto. Brindar apoyo a otras iniciativas de fortalecimiento de capacidades, incluyendo el diseño y la elaboración de herramientas, materiales para talleres o plataformas que aprovechen la inteligencia colectiva de las comunidades y movilicen la acción.

- Apoyar la difusión y el intercambio de datos relevantes y lecciones aprendidas, tanto a nivel de la oficina de país como a escala regional. Mantenerse al tanto de las mejores prácticas emergentes —a nivel nacional, regional e internacional— relacionadas con la labor del proyecto.

- Realizar aportes valiosos a redes de conocimiento y comunidades de práctica. Apoyar la recopilación y sistematización de los conocimientos, productos y herramientas del proyecto, así como su amplia difusión entre los socios.

El titular desempeña otras funciones dentro de su perfil funcional que se consideren necesarias para el funcionamiento eficiente de la Oficina y la Organización.

Arreglos institucionales

El/la Asociado de Proyecto trabajará de forma directa bajo la supervisión de la/el Analista de Proyecto quien a su vez responde al Oficial de Programa que coordina el área GyTP. Además, trabajará estrechamente con el Analista de Programa de GyTP y con otros Analistas y Asociados de Proyecto del área.

Competencias

Esenciales

- Lograr resultados: Nivel 1: Planifica y monitorea el trabajo propio, presta atención a los detalles, entrega trabajo de calidad en los límites establecidos.

- Pensar Innovadoramente: Nivel 1: Abierto a ideas creativas/riesgos conocidos, resuelve problemas de manera pragmática, realiza mejoras.

- Aprender Continuamente: Nivel 1: De mente abierta y curiosidad, comparte conocimiento, aprende de los errores, pide retroalimentación.

- Adaptarse con Agilidad: Nivel 1: Se adapta al cambio, maneja la ambigüedad/incertidumbre de manera constructiva, es flexible.

- Actuar con Determinación: Nivel 1: Muestra determinación y compromiso, capaz de responder calmadamente ante la adversidad, confiado/a.

- Participar y Asociarse: Nivel 1: Demuestra compasión/entendimiento hacia los demás, forma relaciones positivas.

- Facilitar la Diversidad y la Inclusión: Nivel 1: Aprecia/respeta las diferencias, reconoce los sesgos inconscientes, confronta la discriminación.

Competencias transversales y técnicas

- Etica: Conocimiento de las políticas de la ONU – ética: Conocimiento y comprensión del personal de las Naciones Unidas en cuanto a los reglamentos, normas y otras políticas relacionadas con ética e integridad.

- Legal: Conocimiento del marco de referencia de leyes aplicables: Comprensión de las normas jurídicas aplicadas en Naciones Unidas en general y en PNUD en particular. Esto incluye una comprensión de la estructura, el funcionamiento y las operaciones del PNUD dentro del Sistema de Naciones Unidas y la aplicación de los tratados internacionales, incluida la Carta de la ONU, las resoluciones de la Asamblea General, el acuerdo básico de asistencia al país pertinente y los instrumentos legales de todo el sistema de la ONU, así como una comprensión del marco legal interno (reglamentos y reglas financieras, políticas y procedimientos) del PNUD.

- Gestión Institucional: Gestión basada en resultados: Capacidad para gestionar la puesta en marcha de estrategias, programas y proyectos que se centren en la mejora del rendimiento y los resultados demostrables. Conocimiento y comprensión de las teorías, los conceptos, las metodologías, los instrumentos y las herramientas relevantes. Monitoreo y evaluación: Capacidad para monitorear sistemáticamente los resultados de las estrategias, los programas y las actividades con el fin de verificar que se estén llevando a cabo eficazmente. Aptitud para proporcionar a los directivos y a las principales partes interesadas retroalimentación e informes periódicos sobre la coherencia o discrepancia entre las actividades previstas, la gestión del programa y los resultados obtenidos. Capacidad para evaluar de manera independiente la gestión y los resultados de estrategias, programas y actividades, siguiendo criterios y referencias establecidos, y al mismo tiempo considerar las necesidades y preocupaciones de los clientes, tanto actuales como futuros. Conocimiento y comprensión de los marcos, los conceptos, las metodologías, los sistemas, los procesos y las herramientas de seguimiento y evaluación. Capacidad para emitir un juicio independiente con base en los criterios y puntos de referencia establecidos. Capacidad para anticiparse a las necesidades y preocupaciones del cliente.

- Desarrollo de negocios: Generación de conocimiento: Capacidad para investigar información y convertirla en conocimiento útil o adecuado a necesidad mostrada. Habilidad para aplicar conceptos existentes y desarrollar nuevos conceptos para generar soluciones trabajables y nuevos acercamientos. Conocimiento de conceptos relevantes, modelos conceptuales y teorías que pueden ser utilizados para responder a nuevas situaciones. Diseño centrado en las personas: Capacidad para desarrollar soluciones a problemas integrando la perspectiva humana en cada paso del proceso de resolución de problemas Conocimiento y comprensión de los principios y las prácticas del diseño centrado en el ser humano.

- Gestión de asociaciones: Gestión de relaciones: Capacidad para relacionarse con un amplio abanico de asociados públicos y privados, así como para crear, mantener y reforzar las relaciones, la confianza y la comprensión mutua.

Calificaciones mínimas requeridas

Formación

- Educación secundaria es requisito.

- Estudios universitarios (nivel licenciatura) en ramas Económicas, Financieras, Contable, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Derecho u otras afines se dará debida consideración, pero no es requisito.

- El nivel CIPS 2 es muy deseable para este puesto y los candidatos que posean este nivel en el momento de la solicitud tendrán una clara ventaja. Si la certificación deseada no está disponible en el momento de la contratación, deberá obtenerse en el plazo de un año a partir de la contratación. Los candidatos que posean una certificación CIPS de cualquier nivel inferior en el momento de la solicitud tendrán una ventaja proporcional.

Experiencia de Trabajo requerida

Mínimo 6 años (con educación secundaria) o 3 años (con licenciatura) de experiencia profesional en procesos de gestión financiera, logística y adquisiciones.

Competencias y habilidades requeridas

- Experiencia con procesos de adquisiciones internacionales y control de presupuestos.

- Experiencia en el uso de paquete de Office: Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point.

- Experiencia operando scanner, fax, fotocopiadora, etc.

Competencias y habilidades adicionales deseadas

- Experiencia de compras en el Sistema de Naciones Unidas.

- Experiencia de trabajo en proyectos de cooperación internacional con el Sistema de Naciones Unidas u otras agencias multilaterales o bilaterales.

- Experiencia de trabajo en interacción con instituciones nacionales y gobiernos locales.

- Experiencia de trabajo en equipo.

- Experiencia de trabajo en condiciones con contextos difíciles y bajo presión.

Idiomas

- Fluidez en el idioma español es requisito.

- Conocimiento básico del idioma inglés (oral, escrito e interpretación lectura)

Viajes

El/la Asociado de proyecto deberá organizar y participar, cuando se requiera, en visitas a las áreas de intervención de los proyectos, para apoyar las actividades y monitorear el avance de los resultados e indicadores previstos.

Igualdad de Oportunidades

Como empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades, el PNUD valora la diversidad como una expresión de la multiplicidad de naciones y de las culturas en las que operamos y, como tal, invitamos a todo/as los/las candidato/as calificado/as de diferentes orígenes a aplicar a los diferentes roles en nuestra organización. Nuestras decisiones de empleo están basadas en el mérito y la idoneidad para el puesto, sin discriminación alguna.

El PNUD también está comprometido con la creación de un ambiente laboral inclusivo donde todo el personal esté empoderado para contribuir a nuestra misión, sea valorado, pueda prosperar y se beneficie de oportunidades laborales abiertas a todo/as.

Acoso sexual, explotación y abuso de autoridad

El PNUD no tolera el acoso, acoso sexual, explotación, discriminación y abuso de autoridad. Por lo tanto, todo/as los/las candidato/as seleccionado/as, pasan por verificaciones exhaustivas y se espera que se adhieran a los respectivos estándares y principios.

Derecho a seleccionar múltiples candidato/as

El PNUD se reserva el derecho de seleccionar uno/a o más candidato/as a partir de este anuncio de vacante. También podremos conservar las aplicaciones y considerar a los/las candidato/as que apliquen a este puesto para otros puestos similares en el PNUD con el mismo nivel y con descripciones de puesto, requisitos de experiencia y formación académicas similares.

Uso de IA por parte de los candidatos

Se invita a los solicitantes a read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Alerta de estafa

El PNUD no cobra ninguna tarifa en ninguna etapa de sus procesos de reclutamiento. Para mayor información, visite: www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Privacidad de los datos

Por favor click aquí para consultar la Declaración de Privacidad de Datos del PNUD.

jobs.title: Associado(a) de Certificação e Desenvolvimento de Competências em Cibersegurança (1 vaga) (Home Based) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Em 2025, o Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) e o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento (PNUD) firmaram uma parceria voltada à promoção da inovação em segurança cibernética para o Poder Judiciário. O projeto BRA/25/025 – “Fortalecimento da segurança cibernética e da transparência para governança e efetividade da atuação do Poder Judiciário” desenvolve e implementa ferramentas e estratégias para o fortalecimento da segurança cibernética, da preservação digital e da integridade da informação, ampliando a proteção dos sistemas e dos usuários do Judiciário.

A iniciativa fortalece a segurança institucional e promove a transparência, a boa governança e a eficiência dos processos judiciais, contribuindo para a economia de recursos e para uma atuação mais ágil da Justiça em benefício dos cidadãos e da sociedade.

Para isso, a governança do projeto está dividida nas seguintes frentes:

Quatro eixos transversais de coordenação:

- Coordenação Geral;

- Unidade de monitoramento e controle integrado;

- Unidade de gestão técnica e operacional;

- Unidade de formação e comunicação;

Quatro frentes de trabalho, focadas em:

- Compliance normativa;

- Conformidade operacional;

- Governança em rede;

- Fomento à cultura de segurança cibernética;

Por se tratar de uma vaga em regime remoto, espera-se que o(a) candidato(a) disponha de condições adequadas de trabalho, incluindo infraestrutura e equipamentos necessários para o pleno desempenho das atividades.

Deveres e responsabilidades

O(a) Associado(a) de Certificação e Desenvolvimento de Competências estará vinculado(a) ao Eixo 4 de Fomento à Cultura de Segurança Cibernética, com atuação voltada à estruturação e implementação de processos de certificação de competências em cibersegurança, incluindo definição de referenciais, critérios de avaliação e mecanismos de validação e reconhecimento. O(a) profissional atuará em articulação com as equipes do CNJ, PNUD e instituições parceiras.

As seguintes atividades indicativas estão previstas:

1. Estruturação do modelo de certificação em cibersegurança

• Estruturar modelos institucionais para certificação de competências em cibersegurança, definindo níveis, requisitos e critérios de reconhecimento.

• Definir os requisitos necessários para que servidores e equipes possam demonstrar e validar competências em diferentes áreas de cibersegurança.

• Estabelecer critérios de elegibilidade, evidências e mecanismos de concessão das certificações.

2. Avaliação e validação de competências

• Desenvolver critérios e instrumentos para avaliar e validar competências já adquiridas, considerando conhecimentos, habilidades, práticas e resultados demonstrados.

• Estruturar mecanismos de avaliação teórica e prática, quando aplicável, para aferição dos níveis de proficiência em cibersegurança.

• Analisar evidências de competência e recomendar a concessão, manutenção ou evolução das certificações.

3. Referenciais de competências em cibersegurança

• Desenvolver e manter matrizes de competências e referenciais de proficiência para diferentes funções e áreas de cibersegurança.

• Definir os conhecimentos, habilidades e comportamentos esperados para cada nível de proficiência.

• Mapear as competências que podem ser objeto de certificação, diferenciando-as das competências que demandam desenvolvimento por meio de capacitação.

4. Integração com programas de capacitação

• Estabelecer a relação entre capacitação e certificação, utilizando as trilhas de aprendizagem como mecanismos de preparação para os processos de avaliação e certificação.

• Integrar treinamentos, qualificações e experiências práticas às competências previstas nos referenciais de certificação, sem confundir a participação em capacitações com a comprovação da competência.

• Identificar lacunas de competências a partir dos resultados das avaliações e direcioná-las para iniciativas de capacitação e desenvolvimento.

5. Certificação baseada em evidências e práticas

• Trabalhar com Blue Teams, LabCiber, Campanhas e demais frentes técnicas para identificar práticas, experiências e resultados que possam constituir evidências de competência.

• Definir mecanismos para registro e validação de experiências práticas relevantes para os processos de certificação.

• Estabelecer critérios para reconhecimento de competências demonstradas em atividades reais de cibersegurança.

6. Governança, rastreabilidade da certificação e monitoramento e evolução do modelo de certificação

• Estruturar processos de governança para garantir padronização, imparcialidade, consistência e rastreabilidade das avaliações e certificações.

• Manter registros atualizados das certificações concedidas, níveis de proficiência, avaliações realizadas e respectivos ciclos de validade.

• Definir processos para renovação, atualização, revisão ou revalidação das certificações.

• Desenvolver indicadores para acompanhar a evolução da certificação de competências em cibersegurança nos tribunais.

• Analisar os resultados das certificações para identificar lacunas de competências e subsidiar o planejamento de ações de capacitação.

• Promover a melhoria contínua dos critérios, instrumentos e referenciais de certificação, considerando a evolução das necessidades de cibersegurança.

7. Facilitar a construção e o compartilhamento de conhecimento

• Apoiar o planejamento e a realização de treinamentos e capacitações relacionados aos projetos, destinados às equipes de programas, operações e parceiros relevantes.

• Sistematizar e documentar conhecimentos produzidos no âmbito dos projetos, incluindo aprendizados, boas práticas, lições aprendidas e evidências de implementação, organizando-os em formatos e repositórios que favoreçam sua consulta e reutilização.

• Promover a disseminação dos conhecimentos sistematizados no âmbito do projeto/unidade e contribuir para redes de conhecimento, comunidades de prática e plataformas institucionais, visando ao compartilhamento de experiências e ao fortalecimento da aprendizagem organizacional.

O(a) titular desempenha outras funções compatíveis com seu perfil funcional que considere necessárias ao bom funcionamento do projeto.

Arranjo Institucional

A pessoa contratada será supervisionada pela Analista de Gestão de Cultura de Segurança Cibernética.

Competências

- Alcançar Resultados - NÍVEL 1: Planeja e monitora seu próprio trabalho, presta atenção aos detalhes e entrega um trabalho de qualidade dentro do prazo.

- Pensar de forma Inovadora - NÍVEL 1: Aberto a ideias criativas e riscos conhecidos, é um solucionador de problemas prático e faz melhorias.

- Aprender Continuamente - NÍVEL 1: Mente aberta e curioso, compartilha conhecimento, aprende com os erros e pede feedback.

- Adaptar com Agilidade - NÍVEL 1: Adapta-se às mudanças, lida de forma construtiva com ambiguidades e incertezas, e é flexível..

- Agir com Determinação - NÍVEL 1: Demonstra determinação e motivação, mantém a calma diante da adversidade e tem confiança.

- Engajar e fazer Parcerias - NÍVEL 1: Demonstra compaixão e compreensão em relação aos outros, formando relacionamentos positivos.

- Promover a Diversidade e Inclusão - NÍVEL 1: Valoriza e respeita as diferenças, está consciente de vieses inconscientes e enfrenta a discriminação

Competências multifuncionais e técnicas

Direção e estratégia de negócios | Pensamento estratégico: Desenvolver estratégias eficazes e planos prioritários alinhados com a missão e os objetivos do PNUD,

baseando-se em uma análise sistêmica de desafios, oportunidades e riscos potenciais; conectar a visão geral à realidade no campo para criar soluções tangíveis e

direcionadas; aprender a partir de diversas fontes para antecipar e responder de forma eficaz às tendências atuais e futuras; demonstrar capacidade de previsão.

Direção e estratégia de negócios | Perspicácia Empresarial: Capacidade de compreender e lidar com situações de negócios de forma a alcançar bons resultados. Habilidade

para tomar boas decisões e fazer julgamentos rápidos dentro de tais contextos. Conhecimento e compreensão dos marcos operacionais da organização

Desenvolvimento de negócios | Design centrado no humano: Capacidade de desenvolver soluções para problemas envolvendo a perspectiva humana em todas as etapas do

processo de resolução. Conhecimento e compreensão dos princípios e práticas de design centrado no ser humano.

Gestão de negócios | Gestão de Projetos: Capacidade de planejar, organizar, priorizar e controlar recursos, procedimentos e protocolos para alcançar objetivos específicos.

Digital | Gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética e privacidade de dados: Capacidade de antecipar, preparar e responder a riscos e problemas que possam resultar em violações de dados, afetando a reputação do PNUD e causando danos pessoais.

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos: Instituições Eficazes do Setor de Justiça.

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos: Acesso à Justiça

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

Requisitos mínimos de educação:

- Diploma do Ensino Médio completo é requerido.

- Diploma Universitário (Ensino Superior) em Direito, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, ou áreas afins será dada a devida consideração, mas não é um requisito.

Anos mínimos de experiência profissional relevante:

- Mínimo de 7 anos (para Ensino Médio) ou 4 anos (para Ensino Superior) em avaliação de competências e/ou processos de certificação profissional ou institucional em segurança cibernética.

Habilidades requeridas:

- Experiência na uso de tecnologia da informação e pacote office.

Habilidades desejadas, além das competências abordadas na seção Competências:

- Experiência na definição de níveis de maturidade, critérios de classificação ou referenciais de desempenho.

- Experiência no desenvolvimento de matrizes, frameworks ou referenciais de competências e níveis de proficiência.

- Experiência na elaboração de metodologias, instrumentos ou evidências para avaliação de requisitos técnicos e organizacionais.

- Experiência na estruturação de processos de governança, rastreabilidade e gestão de resultados de programas de avaliação ou certificação.

- Experiência na definição e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho, maturidade ou evolução de capacidades institucionais.

- Experiência na articulação com equipes técnicas e instituições para levantamento de requisitos, validação de critérios e implementação de modelos de avaliação;

Idiomas exigidos:

- Fluência em português é requerida.

- Nível intermediário de inglês é desejável.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Data Privacy

Please click here to view UNDP Data Privacy Statement

jobs.title: Programme Associate [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Programme Specialist, the Programme Associate provides leadership in execution of services in the CO Programme Unit, supports the design, planning and management of the country programme by managing data and facilitating programme implementation. The Programme Associate promotes a client-oriented approach consistent with UNDP rules and regulations.

The Programme Associate works in close collaboration with the remaining support staff and personnel of the Programme Unit, as well as with the operations, programme and project teams in the CO and UNDP HQs staff for resolving complex programme-related issues and information delivery.

The Programme Associate will administer and implement programme strategies, adapting processes and procedures, support the management of the CO Programme, provide support to the Programme Unit, support in the creation of strategic partnerships and implementation of the resource mobilization strategy, and facilitate knowledge building and knowledge sharing.

This position has an impact on the overall CO efficiency in programme and success in implementation of programme strategies. Accurate analysis and presentation of information enhances UNDP position as a strong development partner. The information provided facilitates management’s decision making.

Duties and Responsibilities

1. Provides effective support to the formulation and management of the country programme focusing on the achievement of results.

- Assist in collection and presentation of thoroughly researched information for formulation of country programme.

- Assist in preparation and presentation of information and reports for identification of areas for support and interventions.

- Assist in establishment of the mechanisms to track the use of RBM tools and maintenance of the RBM database.

- Continuous monitoring of management targets (BSC).

- Support in monitoring performance indicators/ success criteria, targets and milestones, preparation of reports.

- Contributing to office efforts in achieving its annual targets set in the Country Office Strategic Note.

2. Provides effective support to the Programme Unit focusing on the achievement of results.

- Support Programme Specialist / Officer with programme coordination of assigned portfolio in relevant thematic/sectoral area, ensuring conformity to results, outputs, objectives, and workplans.

- Assist in collecting background information for preparation of draft project documents, workplans, budgets, and implementation arrangements.

- Online creation of a project, preparation of required budget revisions, revision of project award and project status, determination of unutilized funds, and operational and financial closure of projects.

- Proper Control of the supporting documents for payments, review of projects Financial Reports, clearance of advances related FACE forms, and preparation of non-PO vouchers for development projects.

- Contribute to the maintenance of the internal expenditures control system which ensures that vouchers processed are matched and completed, and transactions are correctly recorded and posted.

- Creation of requisitions for development projects and register of goods receipt. Making budget check for requisitions, POs, and vouchers.

- Assist in the analysis of the programme, identification of operational and financial problems, and contribution to the identification of solutions.

- Contribute to the preparation for and support towards the undertaking of DIM and NIM audits, and support for the implementation of audit recommendations.

- Assist the Programme unit by providing guidance to the implementing partners on routine implementation of projects.

- Supporting the coordination of the work of the Project Managers on donor reporting; financial reports; quality assurance, risks management, monitoring, and any other project management issues, while ensuring that quality and deadlines are met.

- Drafting correspondence related to the programme, follow up on it, and respond to queries on programme matters.

- Supporting and facilitating the implementation of the programme on operational related issues and ensuring that UNDP rules and regulations are fully followed.

3. Provides support in the creation of strategic partnerships and implementation of the resource mobilization strategy focusing on the achievement of results.

- Support the preparation of various analysis of information on donors, donor’s profile report and database.

- Assist the review of contribution agreements and managing contributions in Quantum.

- Assist on tracking and reporting on mobilized resources.

4. Ensures facilitation of knowledge building and knowledge sharing in the CO focusing on the achievement of results.

- Ensuring information sharing within the programmatic portfolio.

- Assist in preparation of synthesis of lessons learnt and best practices in programme; provide support in the dissemination and sharing of relevant data and lessons learned within the CO and regionally. Keep pulse on emerging best practices nationally, regionally, and internationally that relate to the work of the assigned project.

- Assist with the organization of trainings for the operations/ projects staff on programme.

- Sound Contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Programme Specialist, the Programme Associate provides leadership in execution of services in the CO Programme Unit, supports the design, planning and management of the country programme by managing data and facilitating programme implementation.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline.​

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements .

- Learn Continuously LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback.​

- Adapt with Agility LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible. ​

- Act with Determination LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident​

- Engage and Partner LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships​.

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination.

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

Business Development

- Knowledge Generation Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need. Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. Knowledge of relevant concepts, conceptual models, and theories that can be useful in addressing new situations.

Business Management

- Risk Management Identify and organize action around reducing, mitigating and proactively managing risks.

- Working with Evidence and Data Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions, and supporting decision-making.

- Results-based Management Ability to manage the implementation of strategies, programmes, and projects with a focus at improved performance and demonstrable results. Knowledge and understanding of relevant theories, concepts, methodologies, instruments, and tools.

Procurement

- Contract Management Knowledge of contract management concepts, principles and methods, and ability to apply this to strategic and/or practical situations.

Finance

- Budget Management Ability to support budgetary aspects of work planning process, drawing and management of team budgets.

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Secondary Education is required.

- University Degree (Bachelor´s degree) in Business or Public Administration, Economics, Political or Social Sciences will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.

Experience:

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Home Based) [Open to Internal and External Applicatns]
jobs.description:
Tier Decription

Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026

Tier 1: Other UNDP/ UNCDF/ UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed term (FTA) appointments (defined as “internal” candidates)

Tier 2: UNDP/ UNCDF/ UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

Tier 3: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates”

Background

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realise the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureaux of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavour with the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery. The Hub aims to build an integrated portfolio collaboratively between the CB and BPPS and establish partnerships with various stakeholders including the UN System, IFIs, civil society, and the private sector. The Hub’s functions involve providing leadership, advising on strategic positioning, managing global programs, developing GRP solutions, and leading crisis response and recovery support. They also focus on knowledge management and learning, establishing thematic and operational partnerships, and mobilizing resources. Thematic areas include peacebuilding, rule of law, local action, governance, human rights, and democratic institutions. Cross-cutting issues address digital transformation, data for SDG16+, and gender inclusion. The initiative aims to ensure that gender dimensions are systematically and measurably addressed in UNDP's GRP work.

Local and regional governments are already responsible of over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part on the implementation of SDGs, that are becoming a new tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long-term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been increasingly active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a strategic framework to deliver better and more innovative public services linked to SDG targets and indicators.

The Procurement Analyst will support participant local and regional governments to improve their PPPs efficiency to align and deliver on Agenda 2030 and will facilitate learning and knowledge generation among municipalities and UNDP country offices around the world.

Scope of Work

SDGs are genuinely interlinked with service provision at local level. Across the world, many cities are transforming their approach to service provision. Taking inspiration from the broad spectrum of targets and indicators offered by SDG, cities are introducing innovative practices and rebuilding the concept of social contract from the local level.

The Procurement Analyst will perform the following key duties and accountabilities:

- Elaborate and manage implementation of innovative and sustainable procurement strategies and policies that are in alignment with principles of fairness, integrity and transparency to achieve best value for money: Ensure full compliance of procurement activities with UN/UNDP rules, regulations, policies, and strategic priorities through effective internal controls and properly used client–oriented procurement management system. Elaborate/establish internal procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), map project/s procurement business processes, and manage workflows in Procurement Unit. Discuss procurement strategies and plans with projects and other stakeholders and donors to ensure mutual alignment. Conceptualizes, elaborates and implements strategic procurement including sourcing strategy, supplier selection and evaluation, quality contract management, contract administration, contract appraisal, cost reduction strategies, customer relationship management, e-procurement, and performance measurement.

- Manage and guide procurement processes for the Business Unit, projects, and other UN Agencies when required: Ensure timely and duly preparation of procurement plans for the Business Unit and projects, and monitor their implementation. Liaise with technical managers, review TOR and provide support to the technical evaluations. Manage implementation of proper monitoring systems, mechanisms and controls for procurement processes that cover RFQ, ITB or RFP, IC, direct contracts, receipt of quotations, bids or proposals, and negotiation of certain conditions of contracts in full compliance with UNDP rules and regulations. Review and certify submission of documents to internal procurement review committees (CAP, RACP and ACP). Ensure management of procurement contracts and perform delegated responsibilities in e-procurement for Purchase Orders approval. Implement the internal control system that ensures purchase orders are duly prepared, dispatched, and corrected on a timely basis when there are errors or other problems. Support project implementation and replication of experiences of local governments wishing to increase citizens participation and public services and public policy co-creation. Implement harmonized procurement services and analyze new opportunities for joint procurement for UN agencies in line with the UN reform.

- Introduce and implement strategic sourcing strategy and e-procurement tools to find best values in marketplace and align purchasing strategy to project and Business Unit goals: Develop and manage rosters of suppliers. Elaborate supplier selection and evaluation criteria, and quality and performance measurement mechanisms. Develop Long-Term Agreements/Frameworks Agreements for more efficient category management. Manage and implement e-procurement system in the Business Unit. Provide technical support to the implementation of the Mayors Challenge initiative within in the assigned portfolio.

- Facilitates procurement knowledge building and knowledge sharing in the Business Unit, CO, Region, UNDP and UN. Elaborate knowledge products able to help UNDP to improve their support to municipalities contracting PPPs for public service delivery. Organize procurement training for the operations and projectpersonnel. Organize procurement training for suppliers on e-procurement modules. Synthesize lessons learned and best practices in procurement. Make sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice. Participate in Operations Management Team (OMT) to share information on cross-cutting areas and collaboration opportunities to achieve greater economies of scale.

- The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

- The Procurement Analyst will report to the Operations Specialist, based in UNDP -Bonn Headquarters and will work closely with other UNDP Offices. Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: May supervise support staff in Procurement Unit.

Competencies

Core

Achieve Results:

LEVEL 2: Scale up solutions and simplifies processes, balances speed and accuracy in doing work

Think Innovatively:

LEVEL 2: Offer new ideas/open to new approaches, demonstrate systemic/integrated thinking

Learn Continuously

LEVEL 2: Go outside comfort zone, learn from others and support their learning

Adapt with Agility

LEVEL 2: Adapt processes/approaches to new situations, involve others in change process

Act with Determination

LEVEL 2: Able to persevere and deal with multiple sources of pressure simultaneously

Engage and Partner

LEVEL 2: Is facilitator/integrator, bring people together, build/maintain coalitions/partnerships

Enable Diversity and Inclusion

LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making

BUSINESS DIRECTION AND STRATEGY Strategic Thinking

Ability to develop effective strategies and prioritised plans in line with UNDP’s objectives, based on the systemic analysis of challenges, potential risks and opportunities; linking the vision to reality on the ground, and creating tangible solution.

Ability to leverage learning from a variety of sources to anticipate and respond to future trends; to demonstrate foresight in order to model what future developments and possible ways forward look like for UNDP.

Ability to research and turn information into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need.

BUSINESS MANAGEMENT Results-based Management

Ability to manage programmes and projects with a focus on improved performance and demonstrable results.

DIGITAL AND INNOVATION Innovation capacity building

Ability to define and create the conditions for trying out new ways of working or introducing new problem solving approaches to an organisation.

Ability to develop, manage and evaluate a learning curriculum that raises awareness, builds confidence, strengthens innovation capabilities around a certain method, tool or technique; or helps develop an innovation mindset.

Ability to create the authorising environment (mandate, incentives) to embed and spread new ways of working.

Ability to align a learning and development strategy with broader innovation strategy.

The ability to acquire goods, services or works from an outside external source

Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system

If the desired certification is not available at the time of recruitment, it should be obtained within one year of recruitment. Candidates holding a CIPS certification at any level below at the time of application will have a proportionate advantage

jobs.description:

De acuerdo con el compromiso de salvaguardar capacidad y apoyar al personal actual de la Organizaciön, la mayoria de vacantes de PNUD/UNCDF/UNV se han anunciado utilizando un proceso de aplicaciön por niveles (tiers) en donde:

• Nivel O: personal internacional del PNUD/UNCDFNNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA), cuyos puestos såran abolidos, o cuyos contratos serån rescindidos o no renovados durante el aio 2026.

• Nivel 1: otro personal del PNUD/UNCDFNNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA).

• Nivel 2: personal del PNUD/UNCDFNNU con nombramientos temporales (TA), personal con contratos PSA regulares y Voluntarios Expertos y Eespecialistas de las Naciones Unidas Skip to main content.

• Nivel 3 0 sin nivel indicado: todos los dernés tipos de contratos del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU y de otros organismos, y dernås candidatos externos.

Descripción de la Oficina/Proyecto:

El PNUD es la principal organización de las Naciones Unidas en la lucha para poner fin a la injusticia de la pobreza, la desigualdad y el cambio climático. Trabajando con nuestra amplia red de expertos y socios en 170 países, ayudamos a las naciones a construir soluciones integradas y duraderas para las personas y el planeta.

Por más de 50 años, el Programa de las Naciones Unidas (PNUD) ha sido un aliado estratégico de Panamá, centrándose en soluciones integradas y alineadas con las prioridades nacionales, apoyando la gestión, implementación y ejecución de programas y proyectos en beneficio de las personas.

El PNUD en Panamá está organizado en tres grupos programáticos que coordinan más de 40 proyectos en todo el territorio nacional:

 Igualdad e inclusión social, económica y ambiental

 Gobernabilidad, paz y derechos humanos

 Cambio climático, gestión integral ambiental y reducción de riesgos y desastres

En el PNUD, la gestión basada en resultados, la igualdad de género, los derechos humanos, el enfoque multidimensional, el desarrollo territorial, la innovación, digitalización y el uso de nuevas tecnologías son transversales en todas nuestras áreas de trabajo y proyectos.

Dentro del Clúster de Igualdad e Inclusión Social, Económica y Ambiental, se brinda asistencia al Gobierno de Panamá en alineamiento con el Marco de Cooperación de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo Sostenible en Panamá 2026-2030 y el Plan Estratégico del PNUD 2026-2030, los cuales destacan la necesidad de fortalecer el capital humano, reducir las desigualdades y apoyar la innovación y el crecimiento sostenible.

El proyecto busca contribuir al desarrollo inclusivo y sostenible de Panamá al mejorar los niveles de cohesión social mediante la inclusión activa de niños, niñas y adolescentes en procesos colectivos de enseñanza musical. Su objetivo principal es cerrar brechas sociales y promover el sentido de pertenencia, confianza en las instituciones y participación ciudadana, especialmente en territorios marcados por la desigualdad y la exclusión.

Se basa en un modelo innovador de enseñanza colectiva de la música —a través de orquestas y coros infantiles y juveniles— que trasciende lo artístico y se convierte en una política pública transformadora que promueve ciudadanía, sentido de pertenencia, equidad de género y el respeto a la diversidad, al tiempo que ofrece nuevas oportunidades de vida para jóvenes en contextos de alta vulnerabilidad.

Alcance del trabajo:

Bajo la supervisión del Asociado/a de Proyecto, el/la Asociado/a de Coros realizará las actividades necesarias de apoyo a la coordinación académica y musical de la Red Nacional de Orquestas.

Las actividades específicas incluyen:

1. Apoyo a la Coordinación Académica y Musical:

• Apoyar en la implementación y actualización de los planes de estudio y formación coral establecidos por La RED.

• Colaborar en la organización y seguimiento de los repertorios secuenciales y repertorios compartidos de las agrupaciones corales.

• Brindar apoyo en el seguimiento de los procesos de formación de las agrupaciones y ensambles corales, de acuerdo con las directrices establecidas.

• Apoyar en la coordinación de metodologías de trabajo y actividades orientadas al fortalecimiento de los procesos musicales del programa coral.

2. Seguimiento y Monitoreo de Programas Corales:

• Dar seguimiento a los cronogramas de clases, ensayos, encuentros y demás actividades de las agrupaciones corales.

• Apoyar la ejecución de los procesos de monitoreo permanente de los programas corales a nivel nacional.

• Colaborar en la recopilación de información sobre el desarrollo de las actividades, avances, retos y resultados del programa.

• Contribuir a la documentación e identificación de lecciones aprendidas y buenas prácticas derivadas de la implementación de las actividades corales.

3. Apoyo Logístico y Operativo:

• Coordinar y dar seguimiento a los espacios, materiales y recursos requeridos para ensayos, encuentros, presentaciones y conciertos.

• Apoyar los procesos de identificación, inscripción y registro de participantes cuando sea requerido.

• Brindar apoyo logístico en la organización de actividades, eventos y presentaciones corales programadas por La RED.

4. Apoyo a Procesos de Evaluación y Selección:

• Participar en los procesos de audición, evaluación y promoción de integrantes de las agrupaciones corales cuando sea requerido.

• Colaborar en el seguimiento de los planes de formación, montaje de repertorios y desarrollo de actividades y etapas del programa coral.

5. Asistir en la Coordinación Institucional y Reportes, y apoyar la gestión de conocimiento:

• Elaborar y presentar informes periódicos sobre las actividades realizadas, avances, dificultades identificadas y recomendaciones de mejora.

• Participar en reuniones, capacitaciones, seminarios y actividades convocadas por La RED, MICULTURA, PNUD u otras instancias relacionadas con el programa.

• Mantener comunicación y coordinación permanente con el equipo técnico y administrativo para garantizar la adecuada ejecución de las actividades corales.

• Apoyar la generación y el intercambio de conocimientos, así como el desarrollo de capacidades, en relación con el proyecto.

El titular desempeña otras funciones dentro de su perfil funcional que se consideren necesarias para el funcionamiento eficiente de la Oficina y la Organización.

Acuerdo Institucional

El/La Asociado/a de Coros trabajará bajo la supervisión directa de el/la Asociado/a de Proyecto.

Esta posición estará basada en la Sede del Ministerio de Cultura.

Movilidad: No se prevé desplazamiento a nivel nacional o en el extranjero. No obstante, en caso de ser necesario los gastos que impliquen movilización, hospedaje y alimentación, de acuerdo con las actividades y requerimientos serán cubiertos por el Proyecto.

jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The Information and Communication Technology Section (ICTS) serves as a strategic enabler and innovation partner for the United Nations Volunteers (UNV), driving digital transformation across the organization. ICTS plays a pivotal role in fostering innovation, with a focus on artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and cutting-edge technologies to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making.

Our mandate extends beyond managing IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, and business applications. We collaborate closely with all sections of UNV as a trusted business partner, aligning technology with organizational goals. ICTS leads governance and strategy initiatives that ensure data security, regulatory compliance, and the implementation of robust digital governance frameworks.

Through a future-focused approach, ICTS drives key digital tracks, including Volunteer Management, Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, Service Management, Cybersecurity, ERP, Digital Advocacy, AI, and the creation of a modern digital workspace. We prioritize accessibility, seamless collaboration, and cyber-resilience, enabling UNV to optimize its volunteer management systems and deliver cutting-edge digital services. By focusing on innovation and strategic technology alignment, ICTS empowers the organization to scale its impact and amplify its mission in advancing global volunteerism.

Scope of Work

UNV maintains its external facing content using Drupal and internal content using Sharepoint. Volunteer learning is offered through the eCampus platform based on MoodleThe applications developer will be responsible for the full lifecycle of UNV applications:

Systems analysis and design

- Elicit, analyze and validate business requirements related to application development;

- Develop software and infrastructure specifications of UNV systems;

- Develop and translate business requirements into application functionality, specifications, and test plans;

- Monitor infrastructural components of UNV applications and suggest options to improved designs;

- Liaise with UNV staff in relevant business units, external IT specialists, and provide specialized advice to users;

- Develop comprehensive system design diagrams, and clear user-facing release notes to streamline codebase maintenance and maintain solution continuity;

- Communicate efficiently with business focal points to align systems enhancement with business requirements, communicate on the implementation progress and develop user guidance materials;
